sentences.text: Hmph. The idea of a haunting is statistically unsound, especially when we have data showing a temperature anomaly in the office.
Between 01:10 and 04:50, the office temperature was observed at 22.2 °C.
This observed warmth is significantly above the expected range of 21.1 °C to 21.6 °C.
Maybe this 'a warmth with no source' was caused by an external heat source or a mechanical issue, rather than any spectral activity.
